items.title: 67255_Helen Humes oral history interview
items.q: A friend of mine, well he was living in Chicago, John Lud.

ctx.x: I knew her from Chicago. That's the first time I met her when I went to Chicago. A friend of mine, well he was living in Chicago, John Lud. And he said, 'Helen I want you to meet this lady that sings. She really is good. She's a gospel singer'.
